messages:
anya: deploybot flagged a compatibility regression: runtime v2.18 vs quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1. error spikes on long sessions. proposing a regional soft-pin + fallback routing.
deploybot: ALERT: compatibility-check failed for model 'quant-v5b' with runtime '2.18' in ap-southeast-1. Suggested action: regional soft-pin to runtime 2.17. error rate: 3.7% on sequences >4096.
sylas: can someone paste the failing log lines? curious if it's checksum or memory OOB.
anya: log snippet from CI-harness:
```
[2026-03-24T02:11:04Z] runtime-2.18 kernelB: kvcache evict_index mismatch shard=4 expected=12288 got=12272
[2026-03-24T02:11:04Z] model quant-v5b: attention_state checksum failed
```
eng-runtime: looks like an eviction window crossing. assigning to runtime team to instrument. early hypothesis: async eviction + quant kernel reorder when seq wraps.
product: if we keep a soft-pin >12h we need a short customer note. @support hold for canned replies.
sre-oncall: routing new sessions to f32-fallback will raise APAC 95p latency ~50ms. I'm adding alerts: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b errors >1% for 5m -> pager; 95p latency >180ms -> pager.
anya: proposed plan: 1) apply regional soft-pin (12h) 2) route new sessions to float fallback only 3) eng-runtime reproduce + patch 4) test in eu-canary 5) lift pin when green. agree?
sylas: +1 regional. global rollback is last resort.
deploybot: Pin request: user=anya, scope=region, region=ap-southeast-1, target=runtime:2.17, model=quant-v5b, mode=soft, ttl=12h -> accepted. pin_id=pin_4567800000.
docs: adding a line to changelog: "APAC: temporary routing to float fallback for quant-v5b on long sequences; regional soft-pin applied." will share draft.
eng-runtime: instrumented kernel with extra eviction trace. running longseq harness now. ETA initial repro: ~1.5h. will open PR if deterministic.
product: i'll draft the customer FYI blurb in case we extend.
sre-oncall: auto-unpin guard set: deploybot will auto-unpin after TTL unless extended. Pager if unpin occurs with no triage note.
support: standing by for canned replies. assign support-runbook.
anya: thanks all. keeping thread as the source-of-truth. will update when repro/metrics change. :white_check_mark:
